title: Amigo scene format v0.1
description: Shared scene format of motionAmigo and spatialAmigo. Units are meters and radians. The world frame is right-handed with z pointing up. Every object is an oriented box: center is the box center, size holds the full edge lengths along the object's local x, y and z axes, and yaw rotates the box about the world z axis. Changes to this format require a version bump.

version.description: Format version. Exactly "0.1" for this schema.

frame.description: Name of the frame all coordinates are expressed in.

viewpoint.description: Optional camera viewpoint, e.g. the observer used to resolve egocentric relations such as 'left of'.

id.description: Unique object identifier within the scene.

size.description: Full edge lengths in meters along the object's local x, y, z axes.

yaw.description: Rotation about the world z axis in radians.

front.description: Optional unit vector in the object frame that points to the object's intrinsic front.
